evidence.e2eOutput: dist/e2e-evidence-p1-complete.txt (EXIT=0, 6 major suites with 11 StoreKit paths pass 100%, node v24.22.1, Windows 10.0.26200)
evidence.scope: Comprehensive server-side StoreKit 2 contract verification (UUID binding, 25h entitlement maintenance, App Store Server Notifications V2 refunds & deduplication, production environment safeguards, account deletion lifecycle). UI rendering verified via 25 screenshots from CI run 42364315988.

P1_1_appAccountToken_binding.details: Deterministic RFC 4122 v4 UUID generator storeAccountUuid(userId) implemented in lib/store.js. StoreKitManager.swift accepts accountUuid: UUID? and attaches .appAccountToken(UUID) purchase option. WalletStoreView.swift fetches accountUuid from /api/store. verifyApple requires matching UUID, rejecting missing or mismatched tokens with 403.

P1_2_refresh_decoupling_and_platform_rou.details: refresh() decoupled from Google Play verifier guard; store_purchases table schema updated with persistent platform column ('ios' / 'android'); refresh() routes to verifyApple vs verifyGoogle based on persisted platform.

P1_3_verified_at_semantics.details: verifyApple updates verified = clock() on re-verification and refresh(), ensuring entitlements (owned() checking verified > clock() - 86400000) remain active permanently. Tested 25h clock advancement in E2E suite without duplicate rows.

P1_4_refund_and_revocation_discovery.details: App Store Server Notifications V2 endpoint POST /api/store/apple-notifications implemented and routed before session auth check. Decodes signedPayload using verifyAndDecodeNotification, reconciles REFUND/REVOKE events to mark store_purchases.state = CANCELLED, revokes owned entitlements, and deduplicates notificationUUID via store_apple_notifications.

P1_5_production_safeguards_and_negative_.details: verifyApple rejects Xcode/LocalTesting environments when NODE_ENV === 'production' with 403. E2E suite covers 11 distinct StoreKit verification paths including negative signature, bundle ID, product mismatch, and environment tests.

externalBlockers.APPLE_BUNDLE_ID: Must be set to production App Store bundle ID (app.kinnect.live)
externalBlockers.APPLE_ENVIRONMENT: Set to Production or Sandbox depending on deployment stage
externalBlockers.APPLE_ROOT_CERT_FILE: Path to DER-encoded Apple Root CA certificate (AppleRootCA-G3.cer) for live X.509 chain trust verification
externalBlockers.APPLE_KEY_ID_AND_PRIVATE_KEY: App Store Connect API key credentials required for server-to-server notifications and server API lookup
externalBlockers.APP_STORE_CONNECT_PRODUCTS: Configured in-app purchase product IDs on App Store Connect must match STORE_PRODUCTS IDs

delete_account_lifecycle.testEvidence: test/test_live_and_contracts_e2e.mjs Section 6 verifies 7 contract assertions: GET info, wrong username 400, confirmDelete false 400, wrong password 403, success 200 with session cookie cleared (Max-Age=0), immediate 401 session revocation on /api/me, and subsequent login rejection.

layoutMatrix.notes: 22 pending substates transitioned to MATCH with distinct screenshot targets and fixtures (consent dark/light, delete-account dark/light, public album, private album, video viewfinder, studio pro sheet, chat delivered/seen status, chat & group menus, wallet/store packages, UGC report); 73 remaining substates strictly preserved.

review_1b0477e_resolutions.atomic_transaction_and_nested_verify: handleAppleNotification no longer swallows nested signedTransactionInfo verification errors; transient verifier errors return 503 for Apple retry; atomic inTransaction block ensures notificationUUID is never recorded before state mutation.
review_1b0477e_resolutions.revocation_tombstones: store_apple_revocations table records transactionId tombstones when refund/revocation notifications arrive, including before any store_purchases row exists; verifyApple checks tombstone table and rejects original/stale JWS with 422.
review_1b0477e_resolutions.notification_uuid_concurrency: INSERT INTO store_apple_notifications ... ON CONFLICT(notification_uuid) DO NOTHING inside inTransaction guarantees race-free duplicate parallel delivery idempotency.
review_1b0477e_resolutions.legacy_unbound_token_restriction: APPLE_ALLOW_LEGACY_UNBOUND only allows pre-existing securely owned records (prior.user_id === userId); first-claim of unbound token is strictly rejected with 403.
review_1b0477e_resolutions.injected_verifier_tests: E2E suite tests malformed nested signatures (422), transient 503 retry, refund-before-client-verify rejection (422), stale JWS re-verify rejection (422), duplicate parallel concurrency (1 processed, 1 duplicate), and legacy unbound first-claim rejection (403).
